about: Forced-choice recognition (evals/eval-protocol.md, 'Recognition'). 'authors' names the real fixture authors (slug: display name and a one-line description for the named judge of the sensitivity test). 'pool' holds the distractors: essayists of about the same period and kind, so a candidate list never gives the true author away by standing out. 'controls' are the positive controls: passages by well-known writers the model should name.

controls.name: Charles Lamb
controls.source: Charles Lamb, 'Dream-Children: A Reverie', Essays of Elia (1823); Project Gutenberg #10343, public domain. The opening, about 360 words.
